thread:
alex.k: kicking off a quick initial staging pass for `vanguard-7b` picked up from model-catalog. goal: basic correctness + tiny quant check so platform teams can smoke the dedicated infra tomorrow

maria_g: nice — can you list the must-have sanity probes? i can run eval harness after lunch

alex.k: minimal list i want covered in this thread:
- tokenization idempotence (text -> tokens -> detokenize == original for ascii/utf8)
- EOS handling for short prompts (no truncation)
- deterministic sample with fixed seed for greedy/temperature=0
- small QA checklist (3 factuals, 2 math, 1 instruction-following)
- quant delta: fp16 vs int8-qa on the 6 probes
- memory / kv-cache warmup: 2-step prompt to ensure cache reuse

cheng: adding a tiny programmatic test i use locally:
```python
prompts = ["What year did the Apollo 11 land on the Moon?", "Solve: 12 * 7 = ?"]
for p in prompts:
    out = client.generate(model='vanguard-7b', prompt=p, seed=42, temp=0)
    assert isinstance(out.text, str)
```
this catches tokenization / generation crashes quickly

sara: i ran fp16 quick-gen on a single T4 in staging, latency ~220ms for 64 tokens which is expected. int8 quant (GPTQ) finished packing, but output for the math probe was `86` instead of `84` — could be quant noise

alex.k: thanks sara — can you paste the exact prompt and both outputs? also include beam vs greedy if available

sara: prompt: "Solve: 12 * 7 = ?"
- fp16 (seed=42, temp=0): "84"
- int8-gptq (same seed): "86"
- greedy vs beam didn't change result

cheng: small variance like that on arithmetic often points to tokenizer alignment or rounding during int8 matmul. let's run logits diff on tokens for both variants to see where mass shifts

maria_g: i have a quick harness to diff logits and token alignments. i'll run on the 6 probes and push results to the staging artifacts bucket. tagging @cheng when done :eyes:

ops_lead: deploy-bot reports one rack in staging with older CUDA driver; recommend validating the int8 run on a host with driver >= 525.x before concluding it's model-level issue

deploy-bot: [automated] image-deploy vanguard-7b-int8 -> staging-eu-3 completed (image sha: ab12cd). no runtime crashes detected in startup logs

alex.k: good catch on drivers. priority-wise: this is P2 for product but P1 for infra diagnostic because we need to confirm if quant config is safe to push to dedicated pools. plan:
1) maria run logits/token-diff on 6 probes (fp16 vs int8) — due EOD
2) cheng run tokenization idempotence across multi-byte samples — due tomorrow morning
3) ops validate driver + rerun int8 on up-to-date host — asap
4) sara assemble a tiny report with examples and attach to model onboarding ticket

maria_g: starting run now. will upload `vanguard-7b/int8-smoke-202403` to s3 and ping here when finished :thumbsup:

cheng: one more quick sanity i want to add to checklist: output-length safety — feed a prompt that expects stop token after bullet list and ensure model respects stop sequence within 3 tokens

alex.k: adding that. also, for the QA probes please include a short perplexity baseline so we can detect egregious degradation automatically (even if small sample)

sara: note — reproducibility tip: include `seed` + exact tokenizer version in the artifact metadata. i ran into ambiguous behavior yesterday when an older tokenizer mapping slipped into the run

alex.k: agreed. metadata schema we expect in artifacts:
- model: name + sha
- tokenizers: repo+commit
- runtime: cuda + driver + docker image sha
- eval-config: seed, temp, max_tokens, stop_sequences

maria_g: upload done. brief summary: 6 probes, token-diff shows a spike in probability mass for token id 5122 in int8 run for question tokens — attaching sample. i'll create a tiny issue with diff visualization

cheng: i'll look at the diff tonight. if it's localized to a single token we might be able to work around by swapping tokenizer mapping or re-run GPTQ with per-channel clipping

alex.k: perfect. thanks all. if nothing major shows up, we can promote `vanguard-7b` to dedicated-canary pool next week and run a larger eval. leaving this thread open for results and attaching artifacts to the onboarding ticket after final checks

ops_lead: quick FYI — schedule a short handoff with oncall tomorrow 10:30 to walk them through int8 failure modes and rollback steps

deploy-bot: [automated reminder] if promoting to dedicated canary, ensure canary policy contains max-rt=500ms and fallback-model=`vanguard-7b-fp16`

alex.k: done. thanks everyone :)
